text: 创业板指、科创50均跌超4%，沪指跌1.78%，深成指跌3.34%，算力硬件、半导体芯片、机器人等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超5000只
text_en: Both ChiNext and STAR 50 fell over 4%, Shanghai Composite down 1.78%, Shenzhen Component down 3.34%, with computing hardware, semiconductor chips, and robotics leading declines; over 5,000 stocks fell across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets
